text.en: The recurring backing-track library and downloadable slide collection at the center of Jam Tracks Hub.
text.zhTW: Jam Tracks Hub 核心的持續更新伴奏音軌資料庫與可下載投影片集合。

text.en: Tracks presents backing tracks as filterable, sortable cards with playable or linked media, musical metadata, and slide downloads. Canonical track records live in data/tracks.json.
text.zhTW: 音軌頁以可篩選、排序的卡片呈現伴奏音軌，包含可播放或連結媒體、音樂中繼資料與投影片下載。正式音軌紀錄位於 data/tracks.json。

text.en: The page is the public library for discovering Jam Tracks Hub backing tracks and their supporting materials.
text.zhTW: 此頁是探索 Jam Tracks Hub 伴奏音軌與配套資料的公開資料庫。

text.en: Browse weekly releases, narrow by musical attributes, open the track, and download related slide material.
text.zhTW: 瀏覽每週發布、依音樂屬性縮小範圍、開啟音軌並下載相關投影片。

text.en: The initial Render deployment included the Tracks area, and W1–W8 established the recurring library and slide series.
text.zhTW: 最初 Render 部署已包含音軌區，W1–W8 建立持續更新的資料庫與投影片系列。

text.en: A public collection of eight confirmed backing-track entries and supporting slides.
text.zhTW: 包含八筆已確認伴奏音軌與配套投影片的公開集合。

text.en: A dedicated tracks.html route separate from the Homepage presentation.
text.zhTW: 與首頁呈現分離的 tracks.html 獨立路徑。

text.en: The earliest public role combined catalog browsing with access to track and slide materials; later structured data made the same role easier to scale.
text.zhTW: 從歷史回溯可見，最早公開角色結合目錄瀏覽與音軌／投影片存取；後來結構化資料讓相同角色更易擴充。

text.en: A track toolbar supplies sorting and filters, including grouped key selection.
text.zhTW: 音軌工具列提供排序與篩選，包括分組調性選擇。

text.en: The Vue-owned page normalizes records, renders cards, builds slide-download actions, and links media while preserving localized titles.
text.zhTW: 由 Vue 管理的頁面會正規化紀錄、渲染卡片、建立投影片下載操作與媒體連結，並保留在地化標題。

text.en: The current script bounds FLIP-style rearrangement by viewport capability and falls back to direct rendering.
text.zhTW: 目前腳本依視窗能力限制 FLIP 重新排列動態，並可回退到直接渲染。

text.en: tracks.html defines the library heading, controls, result host, shared navigation, and footer.
text.zhTW: tracks.html 定義資料庫標題、控制、結果容器、共用導覽與頁尾。

text.en: data/tracks.json stores public track records; the Vue frontend owns normalization, filtering, sorting, card rendering, and downloads.
text.zhTW: data/tracks.json 儲存公開音軌紀錄；Vue 前端管理正規化、篩選、排序、卡片渲染與下載。

text.en: Toolbar controls and a multi-card library prioritize scanning and comparison.
text.zhTW: 工具列控制與多卡片資料庫優先支援掃讀與比較。

text.en: Navigation and covers were specifically refined for tablet widths in late July.
text.zhTW: 7 月下旬曾針對平板寬度改善導覽與封面。

text.en: Filters and cards stack; August 30 fixes focused on responsive footer, video, and track detail behavior.
text.zhTW: 篩選與卡片堆疊；8 月 30 日修正聚焦響應式頁尾、影片與音軌細節行為。

text.en: The first eight entries established the recurring content model.
text.zhTW: 首八筆項目建立持續更新內容模型。

text.en: The catalog expanded while track and Homepage motion evolved.
text.zhTW: 目錄擴充，同時音軌與首頁動態演進。

text.en: Light-interface and responsive work accompanied W16.
text.zhTW: W16 同時帶來淺色介面與響應式改善。

text.en: The confirmed recurring collection reached W19 without inventing a W9 record.
text.zhTW: 已確認的持續集合擴充至 W19，且未虛構 W9 紀錄。

text.en: Tracks, footer, and video details received focused corrections.
text.zhTW: 音軌、頁尾與影片細節獲得重點修正。

text.en: v2.0.4 restored deployable W2–W8 ZIP packages, completing download availability across all 18 supported entries.
text.zhTW: v2.0.4 恢復可部署的 W2–W8 ZIP 套件，讓全部 18 個支援項目都可下載。

text.en: v2.0.5 completed Vue ownership of Tracks within the Vite multi-page architecture.
text.zhTW: v2.0.5 完成音軌頁在 Vite 多頁式架構下的 Vue 管理遷移。

text.en: Tracks is a Vue-owned bilingual public library backed by structured records, filter/sort controls, track links, and downloadable supporting slides across all 18 supported entries through confirmed W19; no W9 record is asserted.
text.zhTW: 音軌目前是由 Vue 管理的雙語公開資料庫，由結構化紀錄、篩選／排序控制、音軌連結與可下載配套投影片支援，涵蓋已確認至 W19 的全部 18 個支援項目；不主張存在 W9 紀錄。

text.en: Recurring content benefits from structured records and grouping; the public history can preserve meaningful collection growth without turning every item into a separate product launch.
text.zhTW: 持續內容受益於結構化紀錄與分組；公開歷史可保留有意義的集合成長，而不把每項都當成獨立產品推出。

text.en: No public record establishes why no W9 entry exists, so this dossier does not speculate.
text.zhTW: 沒有公開紀錄說明為何不存在 W9，因此本檔案不做推測。
